intro.fr: Codename: Kids Next Door, Operation: VIDEOGAME se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Codename: Kids Next Door, Operation: VIDEOGAME can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: High Voltage Software sort Codename: Kids Next Door - Operation: V.I.D.E.O.G.A.M.E. en 2005.
text.en: High Voltage Software releases Codename: Kids Next Door - Operation: V.I.D.E.O.G.A.M.E. in 2005.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub themasterzuku-debug/knd_apworld, qui héberge l'APWorld de Codename: Kids Next Door, Operation: VIDEOGAME.
text.en: The GitHub repository themasterzuku-debug/knd_apworld, home of the Codename: Kids Next Door, Operation: VIDEOGAME APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v1.
text.en: The first version, v1, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v2, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (2 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v2 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (2 versions released).

text.fr: Comme beaucoup de jeux, Codename: Kids Next Door, Operation: VIDEOGAME rejoint Archipelago par un APWorld non officiel : un fichier .apworld distribué à part, que chaque joueur ajoute lui-même à son installation pour l'intégrer à un multiworld.
text.en: Like many games, Codename: Kids Next Door, Operation: VIDEOGAME joins Archipelago through an unofficial APWorld: a .apworld file distributed separately, which each player adds to their own install to bring it into a multiworld.
